While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
items.d: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.
items.fullText: Walmart is embracing agentic commerce with the launch of its own Agent Gateway to manage transactions and other new features aimed at customers using AI agents, the retailer announced on Wednesday. The move comes shortly after Walmart’s top competitor, Amazon, began blocking AI agents from making purchases on behalf of online shoppers. The company’s embrace of AI technology differentiates it from other online businesses, including not only Amazon but also various travel and booking sites, which have responded to the growing consumer adoption of AI agents by locking them out of their websites completely . Walmart, on the other hand, had already announced a partnership with a leading agent in the space, Meta’s Muse, and offers integrations with popular AI apps like ChatGPT, Gemini, and others. Now, it’s expanding on those efforts with more technology to prepare for a world where AI agents become mainstream, said Walmart President and CEO John Furner, speaking at the Masters of Scale Summit in San Francisco on Wednesday. The technology will support agentic shopping from both Walmart and the company’s discount warehouse, Sam’s Club. It starts with Walmart’s Agent Gateway, the company’s new MCP server, which is designed to help approved agents connect to Walmart over the model context protocol (MCP). The protocol, originally created by Anthropic, allows AI agents to connect to external data sources, tools, and other workflows. In this case, it lets an AI agent search across Walmart’s online inventory and make purchases on behalf of the agent’s user. What’s more, the retailer says that its Agent Gateway will be able to help customers shop for their usual brands or items without having to share their personal information or purchase history directly with the agent. items.t: The internet is having a very bad cybersecurity day
items.d: From AI-discovered PHP vulnerabilities to flaws in Node.js and popular AI tool LiteLLM, cybersecurity teams have plenty to worry about this week.
items.fullText: The internet is having a bad day, from a cybersecurity perspective. Government websites around the world went offline , Reuters reported, after AI discovered critical security vulnerabilities that impacted the programming language PHP . The issues were severe enough that the U.S. National Security Agency (NSA) advised organizations using PHP on their systems to either immediately update or take their systems offline until they could. But the PHP update wasn’t the only headache cybersecurity folks were facing on Wednesday. Node.js , the open-source JavaScript runtime environment, also dropped a security surprise of its own when it shared that four high-severity vulnerabilities were just patched in its latest release. One allowed remote code execution, and two others would have permitted a TLS validation bypass, potentially allowing attackers to bypass checks intended to verify a server’s identity. In addition, LiteLLM, a popular open source proxy for routing requests to multiple LLM providers, was compromised by an attacker who injected malicious code, the company shared in a post on X on Wednesday afternoon. The malicious artifacts were published to PyPI (Python Package Index), Docker Hub , and GHCR (GitHub Container Registry), the post noted. The malicious code was said to include an information stealer that targeted cloud credentials, passwords, and AI service credentials, in addition to a remote access trojan that could allow hackers to execute commands on compromised systems. LiteLLM said it has now removed the malicious releases and images and advised anyone who installed them to follow the remediation guidance it provided. And wait, there’s more! An Indian certificate authority, eMudhra, had its private keys compromised , potentially allowing attackers to issue fraudulent certificates and impersonate legitimate websites. items.t: PHP Armageddon: OpenAI, Google’s Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet
items.d: This is the kind of security issue that was found and prevented by AI, but is also a high risk because of AI.
items.fullText: The U.S. National Security Agency’s sent out an alarming warning on Wednesday that two critical holes had been found in PHP, with patches already issued by the PHP Foundation . PHP is a server-side programming language so widely used for web applications that it powers roughly 70% of the websites on the internet; by some accounts, that’s more than 33 million sites . It is also used by popular content management systems like WordPress. The NSA warned that these holes are so severe that if a website can’t be patched immediately, it should be pulled off the web until it can be. The holes allow attackers to infiltrate the server’s file system or a database that may be used by the web app. Interestingly, these holes have been tucked away in all versions of PHP since version 5, which was released in 2004. Websites not running relatively current versions of PHP will have some updating work to do, as PHP 8.1 and older versions are no longer supported. The recommendation is to update the web server to the current version of PHP, which is 8.5.12. So how did two such ubiquitous, decades-old flaws that affect nearly every website on the internet suddenly come to light? AI, naturally, particularly via OpenAI and Google’s Wiz. Security testing company Calif was engaged in OpenAI’s “Patch the Planet” initiative to find flaws in open source software. Using GPT‑5.6 Sol, it found one of the flaws, OpenAI disclosed in a blog post . Separately, the Wiz team also used AI, namely its Wiz Atlas security AI agent, Gemini 4 Argon, and GPT-5.6 Sol to find multiple vulnerabilities in PHP. Both OpenAI and Wiz followed responsible security research practices and worked with PHP on patches before publicly disclosing the flaws. Then they all worked together to flesh out what they found, and test the patches, drawing in a host of others to help. Founded in a tent near the Berlin Wall in 1980, the Tempodrom moved several times before settling near Anhalter Bahnhof in 2001. Its permanent home has since hosted concerts, galas and political events. Today, it hosts a different kind of spectacle. GTC Berlin runs three days, with more than 100 sessions on agentic AI, robotics, physical AI, open models and accelerated computing underway at STATION-Berlin down the road. Here, journalists, analysts and partners have gathered for the main event: NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang’s keynote. Huang Takes the Stage Huang opened with a question: What do L’Oréal, Revolut, Spotify, Merck, Vodafone, Zara, Porsche, Nestlé and HSBC have in common? They’re all European companies and they’re all working with NVIDIA on AI, he said. The keynote comes on the heels of NVIDIA’s weeklong road across Europe — Paris, London, Stockholm, Dublin — with the company committing nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem across Europe and working with 12,000+ partners. “After decades of advancement in the computer industry, we are now at the beginnings of a new industrial revolution,” Huang said. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements AI is a five-layer cake , Huang explained. items.fullText: 테크 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 크래프톤, 독자 LLM 공개…게임 넘어 AI 기술 내재화 속도 입력 2026.10.21 16:05 수정 2026.10.21 16:05 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 안정훈 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 크래프톤이 자체 개발한 대규모언어모델(LLM)을 공개했다. AI 모델부터 인프라까지 핵심 기술을 직접 확보하려는 전략이다. 게임 속 AI 캐릭터와 에이전트 활용이 늘어나는 상황에서 AI 운영 비용을 낮추기 위한 기술 경쟁력을 강화하고 있다는 분석이 나온다. 크래프톤은 21일 300억개 매개변수(파라미터) 규모의 LLM '라온-1 미니' 프리뷰 버전을 공개했다. 모델 설계부터 학습까지 전 과정을 독자적으로 수행했다. 한국어와 영어를 지원하며 글로벌 AI 플랫폼 허깅페이스를 통해 누구나 무료로 내려받아 상업적으로 활용할 수 있도록 했다. 이번 모델의 핵심은 비용 효율성이다. 전체 300억개 매개변수 가운데 필요한 40억개만 활성화하는 전문가 혼합(MoE) 구조를 적용했다. 자체 개발한 선형 어텐션 기술도 결합했다. AI 모델을 구동할 때 필요한 연산량을 줄여 응답 속도를 높이고 추론 비용을 낮추는 방식이다. 크래프톤은 해외 동급 모델보다 우수한 성능을 확보했으며 일부 지표에서는 국내 대형 모델에 근접했다고 설명했다. 시장에선 크래프톤이 AI 원천기술 확보에 속도를 내고 있다는 점에 주목하고 있다. 크래프톤은 지난해 'AI 퍼스트' 기업 전환을 선언하고 1000억원 규모의 그래픽처리장치(GPU) 클러스터 구축에 나섰다. 지난 6월에는 AI 추론용 반도체를 개발하는 국내 스타트업 하이퍼엑셀에 500억원 규모의 전략적 투자를 추진했다. AI 인프라와 반도체에 이어 독자 LLM까지 확보하며 기술 내재화 범위를 넓히고 있는 셈이다. 게임 산업에서 AI 추론 비용은 중요한 경쟁 요소로 떠오르고 있다. 이용자와 실시간으로 대화하고 상황에 맞춰 행동하는 AI 캐릭터가 늘어날수록 연산 비용도 커지기 때문이다. 크래프톤은 엔비디아와 공동 개발한 AI 캐릭터 기술을 활용해 지난 6월 '배틀그라운드'에서 AI 동료 'PUBG 앨라이'의 베타 서비스를 선보인 바 있다. 자체 LLM 기술은 향후 이 같은 게임 AI 서비스를 고도화하고 운영 비용을 최적화하는 기반이 될 수 있다. 이강욱 크래프톤 최고AI책임자(CAIO)는 "5년 넘게 축적한 AI 연구개발 역량을 통해 경쟁력 있는 언어모델을 독립적으로 개발한 성과"라며 "성능은 높이고 비용 부담은 낮춘 가성비 LLM으로 다양한 산업 현장에서 AI 활용의 폭을 넓혀 나가겠다"고 말했다. 안정훈 기자 ajh6321@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 안정훈 ADVERTISEMENT 관련 뉴스 1 엔비디아 "피지컬 AI 승부처는 시뮬레이션"…정부도 실증 지원 "피지컬 AI에서는 시뮬레이션이 굉장히 중요합니다. 실제 환경의 데이터가 부족하고 안전과 비용 문제도 해결해야 하기 때문입니다."정소영 엔비디아코리아 대표는 13일 서울 삼성동 코엑스에서 열린 '피지... 2026.10.13 15:01 2 논란 터진 지 나흘 만에야…"방플 맞다" 크래프톤 결국 고개 숙였다 크래프톤의 대표 지식재산권(IP) ‘PUBG: 배틀그라운드’를 둘러싼 ‘방플’ 논란이 한국 참가자 전원의 경기 불참과 대회 조기 종료, 스폰서십 중단·보류로 번... 2026.09.22 08:49 3 경기 파행에 스폰서 줄줄이 발 뺐다…크래프톤 'PUBG' 무슨 일이 크래프톤의 대표 지식재산권(IP) 'PUBG: 배틀그라운드'를 둘러싼 후폭풍이 거세지고 있다. 아시아 지역 이벤트 대회에서 불거진 공정

items.t: Elon Musk and Anthropic make promises to give the public a piece of the AI pie
items.d: Elon Musk and officials at AI giant Anthropic are pledging to give coveted shares in their companies to the general public as concerns about AI’s economic and societal impact continue to pile up.
items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Elon Musk and Anthropic make promises to give the public a piece of the AI pie The promises come as the public has broadly soured on AI and concerns about its economic impact grow. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Elon Musk is awarded the National Medal of Science during the Golden Age of American Innovation Summit in Washington on Oct. 8. Kent Nishimura / AFP via Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 19, 2026, 10:39 AM EDT By Rob Wile Elon Musk and officials at AI giant Anthropic are pledging to give coveted shares in their companies to the general public as concerns about AI’s economic and societal impact continue to pile up . “Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America,” Musk posted on X on Monday. “This will be the first of many.” One SpaceX share is currently valued at about $150. With approximately 72 million children under the age of 18 in the U.S., Musk’s donation would currently be worth about $10.8 billion — less than 2% of his current net worth. He provided no additional information. Musk could not be reached for additional comment. His statement comes one day after officials at Anthropic said the company would commit 5% of company shares to a “public benefit fund” in order to address “labor market impacts” of AI. In a statement, Anthropic officials said the fund could make charitable donations or direct money to “specific populations,” emphasizing the fund’s “versatility.” “Given the pace of AI progress, bolder approaches may be needed,” they said. Anthropic has been preparing for an initial public offering — releasing its stock for trading on public markets — that analysts say would value the company at more than $1 trillion. The company has long championed employees’ charitable giving by promising to match their donations. Dario Amodei, co-founder and chief executive officer of Anthropic. items.fullText: Open From Data Center to Desktop: NVIDIA Expands Nemotron Family With Highest Efficiency Super VL and Bolt Models 5x faster, accurate and customizable Nemotron 3.5 Super VL expands NVIDIA’s open models for always-on agents, with Nemotron 3.5 Bolt bringing agentic intelligence to local NVIDIA systems. October 15, 2026 by Kari Briski 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA today released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter model that delivers the fastest task completion and highest accuracy for specialized always-on agents. Joining it are two new edge models: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB, optimized to balance intelligence and speed per GB for local agentic workloads, and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, optimized for intelligence per GB for fast conversational agents. Super VL and Bolt 74B-A9B are available now, with Bolt E4B coming Oct. 23. The three open models together cover the full range of agent deployments, from large enterprise servers down to edge devices and local hardware. Any organization that wants to run agents on NVIDIA infrastructure now has an open, optimized model for their tier, without having to choose between capability and deployability. Super VL and Bolt join the Nemotron family alongside Lightning and Ultra. Lightning, released in August, handles high-throughput workloads; Ultra handles the hardest reasoning tasks; and Bolt brings intelligence to the edge. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL: Frontier Accuracy at One-Fifth the Size Super VL, built in collaboration with the Nemotron Coalition , delivers leading accuracy on multimodal agentic tasks — instruction following, tool use, multistep business workflows, and visual understanding — comparable with NVIDIA’s largest reasoning model at roughly one-fifth the parameter count. items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Eight states sue OpenAI over ChatGPT’s alleged harms to users Kansas Attorney General Kris Kobach said states “are not going to hold our breath” for federal legislation to keep AI companies in check. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Eight states sue OpenAI claiming ChatGPT harms children 01:17 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 14, 2026, 7:18 PM EDT By Angela Yang and Joe Kottke Eight states sued OpenAI on Wednesday, accusing it of deceiving parents about the safety of ChatGPT. The coordinated lawsuits — filed individually in Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho and Montana — target the AI giant for the harms its generative AI chatbot is alleged to have caused to ​children in those states. “OpenAI, they wanted to be the first to market. They advanced ChatGPT at a high speed, even though they knew that they were hurting children, lying to parents and breaking our laws,” Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird said at a news conference announcing the legal action. “Everyone must follow the law.” The company’s flagship AI model, ChatGPT, launched the generative AI boom in November 2023, when it exploded into mainstream culture, and quickly became the biggest chatbot in the world. This summer, it surpassed 1 billion global monthly active app users . In recent years, users have increasingly turned to it and other chatbots for everything from friendship to therapy, as well as a slew of agentic tasks in their personal and professional lives. Bird was joined at Wednesday’s news conference by Kansas Attorney General Kris Kobach, Nebraska Attorney General Mike Hilgers and West Virginia Attorney General JB McCuskey.
